    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Band
    A music band that books rehearsal rooms.
    BandController
    REST endpoints for music bands.
    BandRepository
    Repository for reading and saving bands.
    BandRequest
    Data that the client sends to create or change a band.
    BandResponse
    Band data that the API returns, together with HATEOAS links.
    BandResponseMapper
    Converts Band entities to BandResponse objects and adds HATEOAS links.
    BandService
    Business logic for music bands.
    Booking
    A booking of a room made by a band for a specific time.
    BookingController
    REST endpoints for bookings.
    BookingRepository
    Repository for reading and saving bookings.
    BookingRequest
    Data that the client sends to create a booking.
    BookingResponse
    Booking data that the API returns, together with HATEOAS links.
    BookingResponseMapper
    Converts Booking entities to BookingResponse objects and adds HATEOAS links.
    BookingService
    Business logic for bookings.
    BookingStatus
    The status of a booking.
    BusinessRuleException
    Thrown when the given data breaks a business rule, for example when a booking is too long or is in the past.
    CacheControlInterceptor
    Adds a Cache-Control header to every API response (NFR-3).
    ConflictException
    Thrown when an action conflicts with the current state of the system, for example when a room name is already in use.
    ErrorResponse
    Error data that the API returns when something goes wrong.
    GlobalExceptionHandler
    Turns exceptions into JSON error responses with the right HTTP status code.
    OpenApiConfig
    OpenAPI (Swagger) configuration: the title and description of the API (NFR-8).
    RehearsalBookingApplication
     
    ResourceNotFoundException
    Thrown when a requested room, band or booking does not exist.
    Room
    A rehearsal room that bands can book.
    RoomController
    REST endpoints for rehearsal rooms.
    RoomRepository
    Repository for reading and saving rooms.
    RoomRequest
    Data that the client sends to create or change a room.
    RoomResponse
    Room data that the API returns, together with HATEOAS links.
    RoomResponseMapper
    Converts Room entities to RoomResponse objects and adds HATEOAS links.
    RoomService
    Business logic for rehearsal rooms.
    WebConfig
    Web configuration: makes API responses cacheable (NFR-3).
